sources: Statbox Enemy templates of Barm, Squillers, Goldie, Harzia, Gamblin, Ghiavolo, Ghoulette, Gambergar, Toll, Card Sharp, Dandybrine, Mushroulette, Daimon, Knight of Spades, Valentine (retrieved 2026-09-29)
HARPY, DEVIL1, BOSS_XLDEATH reuse ids/stats from gallo-tower/bone-zone files. Most Westwoods enemy names are unofficial; ids other than the wiki-listed EX_* ones are invented (EX_ prefix).

field_notes.hp: max health at spawn before stage multiplier
field_notes.speed: wiki MoveSpeed units (140 is a normal bat)
field_notes.hp_x_level: true means health is multiplied by player level at spawn

EX_SQUILLERS.name: Squillers
EX_SQUILLERS.special: Fixed Direction (crosses the screen, no chasing); HP x Level; wiki ranges hp 1-2, damage 1-2, speed 600-800 (midpoints/upper used)

EX_GAMBLIN.name: Gamblin
EX_GAMBLIN.special: chases player; wiki ranges hp 15-20, speed 140-150 (midpoints used)

EX_CARDSHARP.name: Card Sharp
EX_CARDSHARP.special: chases player; HP x Level; wiki id EX_CARDSHARP

EX_DANDYBRINE.name: Dandybrine
EX_DANDYBRINE.special: boss-type miniboss (Westwoods boss list); HP x Level; wiki id EX_DANDYBRINE; also appears in 17:00/18:00 pools

EX_DAIMON.name: Daimon
EX_DAIMON.special: boss-type miniboss; HP x Level; wiki id EX_DAIMON; also in 18:00 pool

EX_KNIGHT_SPADES.name: Knight of Spades
EX_KNIGHT_SPADES.special: boss (16:00); wiki ranges hp 250-700, damage 20-30, speed 120-180 (midpoints used); two variants

EX_VALENTINE.name: Valentine
EX_VALENTINE.special: boss (18:00) and 19:00 pool; HP x Level

BOSS_XLDEATH.name: The Reaper
BOSS_XLDEATH.special: spawns 30:00 and each minute after; rushes player; contact deals lethal damage
